title: YouTube Faces $3 Billion Settlement in School Lawsuits
excerpt: YouTube may pay up to $3 billion to resolve lawsuits from school districts alleging the platform causes social media addiction in teens.
body_html:
YouTube is reportedly facing potential settlement costs of up to $3 billion to resolve ongoing legal challenges brought by school districts. The legal actions claim that the video platform is intentionally designed to be addictive, which has resulted in harm to teenagers.

The platform currently confronts an increasing volume of complaints focusing on youth engagement and platform design. These lawsuits highlight growing institutional concerns regarding the impact of online services on younger users within educational communities.
